g3-implement.imperative: Implement src/physics/layer2/stint_estimator.py and the decay_fit helper. LATERAL-LEAD: lateral view first (primary signal), traction second, then braking/powerdrag/coast (honest-null on k). Dispatch constellation-implementer. Wait for IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: constraint:physics_region_no_evo_import
LATERAL-FIRST: lateral view is the primary decay instrument (#443 finding — braking grip null on compound); build lateral decay first, confirm it works, then traction
Injectable (k, sigma_k) prior: default weakly-informative (mu=0.01, sigma=0.02, units=1/lap); W3 will override with pooled compound prior
Age covariate = ABSOLUTE tyre_life (NOT normalized); per-sample age from lap_num -> tyre_life mapping from RaceStintData
Honest-null: braking/powerdrag/coast are fitted with k=0 (standard 2-param frontier over full stint pool); return k=None or k=0.0 with null covariance for those views
Do NOT modify existing LateralView, TractionView, BrakingView, PowerDragView, CoastView classes — the decay fit lives in the new stint_estimator / decay_fit helper only
Do NOT modify session_estimates table or EstimateStore

structural: struct:physics.layer2 — src/physics/layer2/decay_fit.py (NEW helper, or inline in stint_estimator)
capability: RaceStintData (from session_race.py) — provides v, age, processed_df, mass_kg, rho per lap
frontier_fit.fit_frontier — reused for non-decay views (braking/powerdrag/coast) over full stint pool
scipy.optimize.minimize — for non-linear decay fit (g0, k, b_aero) — NOT linear design
constraint: One-sided upper-frontier loss applies to decay fit (same philosophy as fit_frontier — frontier must bound the cloud from above)
injectable prior on k: default ParamPrior(mu=0.01, sigma=0.02); W3 seam is the injection point
decision: Lateral-first: lateral_grip(v, age) = g0*exp(-k*age) + g_aero*v^2; traction_accel(v, age) = a_t0*exp(-k_t*age) + b_t*v^2; braking/powerdrag/coast = 2-param standard fit with k=0
evidence: StintEstimate.lateral_decay.g0 > 0 on VER Bahrain stint 1 SOFT
StintEstimate.lateral_decay.k >= 0 for SOFT compound (positive decay expected)
